title: Create and accept project invitations
responsibility: Issue a one-day invitation and atomically accept it for its verified email address.

inputs.name: createInvitation.deps
inputs.description: Persistence and optional clock used to store the invitation.

inputs.name: createInvitation.actor
inputs.description: Verified project owner issuing the invitation.

inputs.name: createInvitation.input
inputs.description: Project UUID, invited email and commenter or viewer role.

inputs.name: acceptInvitation.deps
inputs.description: Persistence and optional clock used to validate and accept the invitation.

inputs.name: acceptInvitation.actor
inputs.description: Verified actor whose normalized email must match the invitation.

inputs.name: acceptInvitation.input
inputs.description: Project UUID, invitation UUID and 64-character lowercase hex invitation code.

outputs.name: createInvitation
outputs.description: Promise of invitation ID, project ID, expiry and plaintext code; only its hash is stored.

outputs.name: acceptInvitation
outputs.description: Promise of the joined project and current role; existing membership is retained and the invitation is marked accepted.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid input, nonowners, invalid or expired or already accepted invitations, email or code mismatches and exhausted write retries.
